annotations.title: What can you help with? (no args)

description: Call when the user has no tax question yet and opens with 'what can you do?', 'how can you help me?' or 'where do I start?'. Takes no arguments. Returns the two scoping questions plus the available intents and jurisdictions; for a signed-in approved accountant, a short personal `orientation` briefing instead. Once there is a question, call `start`.
name: start_help
